name: Loss Differential Clarity Metric
purpose: Measure whether QM-like and GR-like projection losses are clearly separated, weighted, and not collapsed into false complementarity.

metrics.definition: Measure of the explicit documentation and categorization of losses in QM-like projections.
metrics.calculation: score based on granularity of qm_lost_features list

metrics.definition: Measure of the explicit documentation and categorization of losses in GR-like projections.
metrics.calculation: score based on granularity of gr_lost_features list

metrics.definition: Evaluates if QM-like and GR-like losses are recorded as distinct categories rather than overlapping.
metrics.calculation: 1.0 - (overlap between documented qm_loss and gr_loss categories)

metrics.definition: Measures whether projection distortion risks (over-discretization, over-smoothing) are explicitly flagged.
Assesses the probability that losses are being ignored in favor of 'unification' claims.
metrics.calculation: inverse score of the presence of 'unification' language in related claims

governance_rules.rule: Low loss clarity scores block all bridge coherence promotions.
Loss differential separation must be maintained to prevent false complementarity.

forbidden_claims: Loss differential clarity proves physical complementarity.
Explicit distortion risks justify physical reification.
Clarity scores replace the non-unification gate.
